utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the repair drive location, Rosa, and I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—just let me know as soon as you have it, and I’ll keep the volunteers lined up in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, Rosa—I’m still on it and will tell you as soon as I confirm the location.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good to me — I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces, so I’ll help spread the word on the urgent stuff first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be a huge help, Nell—thanks! I’ll keep you posted as soon as I hear what’s most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll pass along the urgent updates as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing—I’ve got it written down: tools, spare wire, and a couple of lanterns. I’ll bring what I can to help out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s really helpful, thanks. I’ll see if I can round up a few more tools and lanterns too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—every extra tool helps. I’ll keep an eye out for any spare wire or gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it—tools, spare wire, and a couple of lanterns. I’ll write that down right now and see what I can bring over before I forget.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Oren — that sounds right. I’m just confirming: broken fence by the community lot, and we’re meeting at the corner near the mailbox, correct?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, that’s right — the broken fence by the community lot, and the corner near the mailbox. I’m writing it down now so I don’t mix it up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 still works for me. I can help spread the word around the school schedule, too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — Saturday at 10 works for me too. I’ll bring a couple tools and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Noah — I’ll let a few school families know and keep an eye out for the exact location. See you Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great, Uli—there’s always something to pitch in on. Swing by when you can, and I’ll point you to whatever still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll swing by when I can and bring the list over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds perfect, Uli—bring the list over and I’ll help sort out what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks are dropping off tools and parts already. I’ll check back later and see if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — could you check whether they need any extra hands or a specific list of repairs prioritized?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll stop by after my errands and ask whether they need extra hands or a priority list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll bring my gloves and stop by once everything’s set so I can help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll keep everyone updated if anything changes, and I’ll fill you in when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. I’ll come by once it’s set and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Tess — I can sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the table while you set things up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be a big help, Sam—thank you. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new about what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, Tess—just let me know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the exact time and drop-off spot before I can plan the rest properly. Once we have that, I can help make sure we don’t miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—so the repair drive is still on, we just need the exact time and drop-off spot first, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, exactly. Once we have the time and drop-off spot, I can help keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Leo, sorry I’m late — is the repair drive still going on? I’m on my way and can help out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still going. Just need the cracks patched and the loose edge by the gate leveled out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head over now and help patch the cracks and level that edge by the gate.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks, Bo — just come by if you can, and any tools you can spare would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can do that—what’s the quick version of what needs fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly a few hands and any tools folks can spare—if you’re free, come by and I’ll put you to work.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll stop by when everything’s set and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — just let me know when you’re ready, and I’ll help wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Appreciate it, Dane. I’ll wait until it’s all set, then I’ll come by with my gloves and help sort things out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning at 10 still works for me. I can help spread the word around the school schedule, too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—Saturday at 10 works. What’s the quick list of what still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly the usual small stuff—loose handles, a leaky faucet, and a couple of squeaky doors. If you’ve got a fuller list, I can help match it to volunteers around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — the quick fix is patch the cracks and level the loose edge by the gate. If you can help with that, we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Leo — I can patch the cracks and level that loose edge by the gate. I’ll get right on it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Gus. Thanks — that should cover it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort donations and help carry the boxes this Saturday. Just let me know where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Sam—thank you. I’ll put you on donations and box-carrying for Saturday, and I’ll send the time and place once I finish the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Rosa — thanks. I’ll be ready on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — so it’s the broken fence by the community lot, and we’re meeting at the corner near the mailbox, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, that’s right — the broken fence by the community lot, and we’re meeting near the mailbox corner.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks — I’ll keep it to the broken fence by the community lot and the corner by the mailbox.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo—work gloves and a screwdriver would be perfect. And if you can make it, I’d love for you to swing by and lend a hand at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: You got it—I’ll bring the gloves and screwdriver, and I’ll swing by to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Wonderful, Cleo—thank you! I’m already spreading the word, so I’ll make sure folks know you’re coming by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Let’s start with the urgent safety issues first—leaky roofs, broken heaters, and anything else that needs fixing right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That makes sense, but can you confirm the exact drop-off time and the community center address on Oak Street? I need the details to plan my part properly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday at 10, community center on Oak Street. I’ll check on parking and loading details too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll swing by later and see what’s been claimed. Hopefully we can keep it moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on, right? And do we have the date and missing supplies nailed down yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, it’s still on — from what I’ve heard, it’s going well. I’ll check the date and what supplies are still needed when I swing by after errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by and let everyone know what’s going on. Come by when you can, and I’ll fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I’ll swing by when I can and help spread the word too. Just point me to the biggest needs, and I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great — right now we mostly need people to keep folks updated and a few extra hands to sort things out. I’ll fill you in when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ve got it written down now—tools, spare wire, and a couple lanterns. I’ll bring what I can and make sure I don’t forget again.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Oren—those are all super helpful. I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if anything else is still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Tess. If you hear of anything else, just let me know—I’ll keep my note handy.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a big help—just come by when you can, and I’ll have something for you to fix.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I’ll stop by and help with the urgent repairs first. If there’s anything that’s a safety issue, let me know and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey—that means a lot. I’ll point out the safety stuff first when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking it, but I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm the repair drive location.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — I’m just waiting on the location too. Please let me know as soon as you confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still checking, Nell, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm the repair drive location.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
